description.en: Ensure the esophagus is clear of residual food/fluid before mucosal incision; exclude esophageal cancer or pseudoachalasia by inspection.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for thorough esophageal cleansing but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs thorough esophageal cleansing independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches thorough esophageal cleansing to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
